label: TP
reason: User-controlled parameter flows directly to response.getWriter().format() without sanitization. The switch target is hardcoded ('C'), causing param=user-input to be assigned to bar variable which is then passed to format method. X-XSS-Protection header is explicitly set to '0' disabling browser protections.

evidence.note: User input from getParameterNames() flows through switch statement to bar variable then to format() sink without encoding/sanitization
response.getWriter().format(Locale.US, bar, obj) - sinks user-controlled bar variable directly into output stream
